title: precision bearings, guide modules and handling joints

specimens.name: Cross-roller bearing block
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. ONE cross-roller bearing block with a large circular bore. Cut away a wide wedge of the race to show FOUR LARGE SHORT CYLINDRICAL ROLLERS side by side, with their cylinder long axes alternating in visibly distinct directions: first diagonal /, second diagonal backslash, third /, fourth backslash. Every adjacent pair meets at 90 degrees, forming a clear alternating criss-cross race, no parallel-only rows. No loose pieces.

specimens.name: Linear rail carriage
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. ONE short precision linear rail with ONE compact rectangular captive carriage, its end cutaway revealing a loop of small recirculating rollers. No motor, no rack, no long rail.

specimens.name: Harmonic-drive joint module
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. ONE compact harmonic-drive joint module, shown as a large open physical cutaway. The stationary rigid ring has a CONTINUOUS UNBROKEN CIRCLE OF INWARD METAL TEETH INCLUDING LEFT AND RIGHT SIDES. Inside it place a thin flexible oval metal spline ring, with outward teeth along its ENTIRE circumference, around an oval wave generator. At the LEFT and RIGHT ends the outer and inner teeth must physically alternate tooth-gap-tooth like two meshing gears, with gray outer teeth entering gaps between golden inner teeth. Both sets of teeth remain visible and do not vanish at the contact zones. Top and bottom of the oval remain visibly separated from the outer teeth. One physically connected housing, not an infographic, no text, no robot or motor. Use an oblique three-quarter cutaway with the contact patches front-facing and large enough to see alternating inner and outer gear teeth. The gray outer teeth must NOT disappear at the left or right contact patch.

specimens.name: Telescopic guide sample
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. ONE short partially extended telescopic guide sample with two nested rectangular sections, visible sliding shoe inserts and one fixed end-stop at each end. No rail carriage and no actuator.

specimens.name: Quick-fit tool coupler
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. ONE compact round quick-fit mechanical tool coupler made of TWO coaxial mating discs IN PHYSICAL CONTACT, partly engaged at the rim, with a visible rotary bayonet locking ring and three locking lugs entering matching slots. Both discs touch and form one joined assembly, NO gap, NO exploded view, no separate tool or loose piece.

specimens.name: Vibration-isolated foot
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. ONE compact equipment mounting foot with metal top and base plates separated by a visible dark rubber isolation layer, central captive stud and four short mounting holes. No floor tile or raised-floor pedestal.

specimens.name: Sensor-ready clevis pivot
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. ONE forked clevis pivot joint with captive transverse pin, a small sealed sensor housing and one empty cable port; show a physical angular end-stop lug touching a fixed boss. No hanging cable, no motor or complete actuator.

specimens.name: Enclosed leadscrew carriage
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. ONE short enclosed leadscrew carriage with a stationary end bearing, short leadscrew visible in one small housing cutaway and a travelling nut block, no separate motor, no long guide rail or exposed complete machine.

global_forbidden: text, labels, numbers, logos or pseudo-writing
ninth specimen, extra loose part, repeated, merged, substituted or omitted specimen
whole building, vehicle, radar, crane, robot, launch complex, room, scene or finished gameplay asset
photorealistic CAD/PBR render, airbrushing or photographic material
baked cast/contact shadows, glow, rays, motion blur or active FX
E2 exposed motor-and-gearbox assemblies and dense external wiring
independent servo motors, thermal jackets, belt cassettes, encoder caps or rotary yokes from E3 sheet 01
E4 autonomous robots, E5 holograms and levitation

era_contract.character: E3 / 2015 precision serviceable mechanics: compact, protected and repeatably manufactured bearings, guide modules, handling interfaces and physically plausible joints in off-white anodized metal and dark functional elastomer. Finished cohesive HD pixel art.
required_signals: eight mechanically distinct isolated physical examples, each in its assigned cell
bearing, roller carriage, harmonic joint and telescopic slide must have different silhouettes and visible working geometry
tool coupler, isolator foot, sensor-ready clevis and leadscrew carriage must each show its causal mechanical interface
no entire robot, vehicle or facility; only short serviceable components
style bible verbatim with upper-left lighting and deliberate pixel clusters
replaced_previous_language: E2 exposed joint bearings and simple roller carts evolve into preloaded crossed-roller bearings and sealed recirculating guide cartridges
E2 bulky motorized handling assemblies give way to compact nonmotorized quick-fit interfaces and protected lead-screw housings
E2 mechanically exposed joints gain sealed sensing access and explicit physical stops
forbidden_regressions: repetition of E2 standalone exposed bearing eye, open roller carriage and bulky exposed winch
near-identical sliding boxes or repeated rotary actuator yokes
photorealistic catalog rendering or whole machine
